topic: Currency HUD and responsive Memory Grove detail
currentUserGoal: Prevent Memory Grove text collisions at short window heights, make the top currency HUD more visually interesting, and give available Grass Touches stronger visual priority.
workCompleted: Split the active-run currency readout into two compact icon-backed plaques for Run Touches and Grass Touches.
Gave Grass Touches the stronger gold-and-green treatment while keeping Run Touches visually distinct in cyan and teal.
Added a prominent rooted-grass currency badge to the Memory Grove header with a large live value and subtle ambient icon motion.
Made currency value changes pulse briefly without creating update-loop tweens when the value is unchanged.
Reworked the Memory Grove detail panel into measured body and status regions so descriptions, costs, and availability cannot occupy the same space.
Added compact mobile detail copy and responsive font fitting for constrained heights.
Adjusted the mobile Memory Grove vertical layout to reserve room for the new currency badge and stacked detail panel.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 179 Vitest tests across 22 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Verified the actual ecosystem Memory Grove and active-run HUD at 1723x812, 1280x720, and 390x844.
Confirmed the short-window Memory detail description and purchase status use separate regions with no overlap.
Confirmed both currency plaques remain readable without colliding with Options, Ancient HP, or Scourge text.
Confirmed the phone Memory Grove stacks its detail panel cleanly below the web.
Browser diagnostics contained no warnings or errors.
git diff --check passed apart from the repository's existing Windows LF-to-CRLF notice.

gitStatus.expectedAfterCommit: Currency HUD and Memory detail checkpoint committed locally; master is two commits ahead of origin/master and has not been pushed.

knownIssues: The playtest debug control panel intentionally overlays the lower-left corner and is not part of the production interface.
The Memory Web still relies on zoom for dense late-game labels; this slice improves surrounding currency and detail readability rather than redesigning node-label culling.
nextRecommendedSteps: Hands-on check the active currency plaques and short-window Memory detail once in the user's normal browser.
Return to the early Growth and first-expansion pacing work after this readability slice is approved.
Push master and run the Mac handoff workflow only when the user requests a cross-machine or production sync.
doNotRevert: Do not combine Run Touches and Grass Touches back into one plain text string.
Do not independently bottom-position Memory detail status text without reserving body-copy space.
Do not touch docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
Do not cite the legacy 1200-tile harness as ecosystem performance evidence.
